description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2]/[40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2] and [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[40% Damage Reduction Barrier 3] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF1 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Thief] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next two attacks

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 3
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next three attacks

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Thief
description.text: Thief abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 1 additional time
